rationale: The original long thesis relied on price holding tight consolidation around $41.77-$41.80 above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($41.66) against a -2.08% SPY tape. Since entry, SPY has deteriorated further to -2.64%, while BIPC has broken down out of its consolidation, dropped below the 5-minute 9-EMA, and is now pressing session VWAP ($41.62) on consecutive lower highs and lower lows over the last five 1-minute bars. With zero follow-through (MFE of just 0.02% in 14 minutes) and broad market selling accelerating, closing now mitigates the high probability of a breakdown through VWAP toward the $41.58 hard stop.
